# Mocha Reign Natural Hair Studio & Boutique

> Loc specialists in Tallahassee, Florida. "a natural hair & body Art studio" owned by Tia "MochaReign" Simmons. Traditional locs, micro locs (interlocking), wicks, starter locs, loc styles and updos, loc repair and reattachment, kids locs and hair paint. Every new client starts with a free 15-minute consultation (Tuesdays and Wednesdays only). Appointment only; no walk-ins.

Facts below were checked on 28 Sep 2026 against the studio's Booksy page, Google Business Profile and Instagram.

## Key facts
- Business name: Mocha Reign Natural Hair Studio & Boutique (listed on Booksy as "Mocha Reign Studios")
- Owner: Tia "MochaReign" Simmons (Instagram @mochareign)
- Stylists: Tia "MochaReign" Simmons; Jasmine "Jazz" Williams
- In business since 2010 (Florida LLC)
- Address: 1533-4 South Monroe Street, Tallahassee, FL 32301
- Phone: (850) 666-0791
- Hours (as listed on Google): Tuesday to Friday 8:30 AM to 8:30 PM; Saturday 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM; Sunday and Monday closed. By appointment only.
- Booking: https://booksy.com/en-us/86539_mocha-reign-studios_hair-salon_15826_tallahassee
- Reviews: 5.0 on Booksy from 670 reviews; 4.6 on Google from 70 reviews
- Listed on Google as Black-owned and women-owned
- Amenities: parking, credit cards accepted, accessible, Wi-Fi
- Tia is a traveling stylist (ask at consultation)
- Products: MochaReign hair care line in development; a Hair Growth Oil is "coming soon"

## Policies
- All new clients must book a free 15-minute consultation first, Tuesdays and Wednesdays only
- No walk-ins
- Micro loc maintenance: 6 to 8 week window; +$10 per week after week 8
- Kids services: ages 9 and younger
- Loc reattachment requires a consultation and a deposit

## Starting prices (Booksy, 28 Sep 2026; "+" = starting price)
- Consultation: Free (15 min)
- Micro Mini Install: $2,500+ (13 hr)
- Micro Loc Maintenance (interlocking, existing clients): $180+ (3 hr 30 min); with style $200+ (4 hr)
- Loc Illusion Micros Wash & Style: $90+ (2 hr)
- Loc Maintenance (interlocking) without style: $110+ (3 hr); with style: $125 (3 hr 30 min)
- Traditional loc maintenance, no style: $95+ (2 hr); with simple style: $110+ (2 hr)
- Loc maintenance with rope twist $120+; with 2-strand twist, krinkles (plaits), pipe cleaners or loc petals $135+
- Starter Locs (traditional): $175+ (4 hr 30 min, consultation required)
- Loc Reattachment: $350+ (5 hr, consultation and deposit)
- Wick Install (loc combining): $550+ (5 hr 30 min); Wick Maintenance: $150+ (3 hr 30 min)
- Loc Style Only: $35+ (30 min); Loc Knots Style Only: $55+ (1 hr 30 min); Loc Illusion Wash & Style: $65+ (1 hr)
- Shaved sides and back, loc maintenance top only: $85+ (1 hr 30 min); with simple style $100+ (2 hr)
- Kids Starter Locs $95+ (2 hr); Kids Loc Maintenance $60+ (1 hr 30 min); with style $75 (1 hr 30 min)
- Loc Detox $35+; Wash, Condition & Blow Dry $35; Trim & Treatment $40+; Big Chop $35+; Take Down Locs & Braids $35+ per hour
- Braid Styles without Extensions $85+ (2 hr 30 min); Crochet Braids with hair included $165 (2 hr 30 min)
- Hair Paint (temporary color wax): $65+ (1 hr 30 min)
